edges.reason: msg.sender is read during the Owned constructor to seed ownership.
Constructor writes msg.sender into the privileged owner state variable.
acceptOwnership gates execution on msg.sender == newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner (the caller) to owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner after the handover.
transferOwnership stages the pending owner in newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before running.
onlyOwner modifier on the rescue function gates on msg.sender.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] with the caller-supplied amount.

transfer relies on safeAdd for the balance credit.

transferFrom rewrites balances[from] and balances[to].

transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient credit.
